kev_metadata.shortDescription: The Chakra JavaScript scripting engine in Microsoft Edge allows remote attackers to execute remote code or cause a denial of service (memory corruption) via a crafted web site.

kev_metadata.notes: This vulnerability affects a common open-source component, third-party library, or a protocol used by different products. Please check with specific vendors for information on patching status. For more information, please see: https://git.codelinaro.org/clo/la/kernel/msm-4.19/-/commit/1e46e81dbeb69aafd5842ce779f07e617680fd58;  https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2023-33106
kev_metadata.requiredAction: Apply remediations or mitigations per vendor instructions or discontinue use of the product if remediation or mitigations are unavailable.
kev_metadata.shortDescription: Multiple Qualcomm chipsets contain a use of out-of-range pointer offset vulnerability due to memory corruption in Graphics while submitting a large list of sync points in an AUX command to the IOCTL_KGSL_GPU_AUX_COMMAND.
kev_metadata.vulnerabilityName: Qualcomm Multiple Chipsets Use of Out-of-Range Pointer Offset Vulnerability

title: Qualcomm Multiple Chipsets Use of Out-of-Range Pointer Offset Vulnerability

kev_metadata.requiredAction: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions, follow applicable BOD 22-01 guidance for cloud services, or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.
kev_metadata.shortDescription: Microsoft Windows New Technology File System (NTFS) contains a heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability that allows an unauthorized attacker to execute code locally.
kev_metadata.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Windows NTFS Heap-Based Buffer Overflow Vulnerability

title: Microsoft Windows NTFS Heap-Based Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
